question: What services do you offer?
answer: Nurse-led mobile IV hydration, vitamin boosts, personalized consultations, and group and corporate wellness visits. Optional wellness add-ons like red light and aromatherapy can be added to an appointment. Shary comes to your home, office or event.

question: How do I get started?
answer: Three steps: request an appointment (share your name and email, then choose a service and time on our secure booking page), complete a health screening and assessment, and Shary comes to you.

question: Is IV therapy right for me?
answer: Not everyone is a good fit for IV therapy, and that's why every appointment starts with a health screening. If anything in your screening or at your visit suggests an IV isn't right for you, Shary will tell you and suggest you speak with your doctor.

question: Who places my IV, and how is safety handled?
answer: Shary, a registered nurse with more than 17 years of nursing experience, places and monitors every IV herself. She uses sterile, single-use supplies and stays with you for the whole visit.

question: What happens during my appointment?
answer: Shary arrives at your location, reviews your screening with you, and checks your vital signs. She then places your IV and stays with you while it runs. Most of the visit is simply time to sit back and rest.

question: How do I book?
answer: Start on our Book page. After you share your name and email, you'll continue to our secure booking page on Hydreight to choose your drip and time.

question: Where do you travel, and is there a travel fee?
answer: Shary is based in Lakewood Ranch, FL and comes to you.

question: How long does a visit take?
answer: Visit length depends on the drip and any add-ons you choose.

question: Who comes to my appointment?
answer: Shary, a registered nurse, comes to your appointment herself.

question: What happens before my appointment?
answer: Every appointment includes a confidential health screening on Hydreight, our secure booking partner, and Shary reviews it before your IV begins. Your health information stays there, never on this website.

question: Can I add red light or aromatherapy?
answer: Yes, as optional add-ons to an IV appointment. After you book, add them on our Add-ons page, or ask Shary at your visit and pay by card then.

question: How do I pay?
answer: IV services are booked and paid on Hydreight. Add-ons can be paid by card online on our Add-ons page, or at your visit.

question: What's your cancellation and refund policy?
answer: Our cancellation and refund policy will be posted here.

question: Do you offer group or corporate visits?
answer: Yes. Shary coordinates mobile IV services for private groups, workplaces and special events. Tell us about your event on our Group & corporate page.

question: ¿Hablas español?
answer: Sí. Shary habla inglés y español. Puedes llamarnos o escribirnos en español.

heading: Shary Gonzalez, RN, BSN
intro: Shamarith "Shary" Gonzalez is a registered nurse with a BSN, more than 17 years in nursing and 25 years in healthcare. She founded Avida Luna to bring professional, personalized care directly to her community.

sections.text:
Shary started Avida Luna because she wanted care to feel personal again: one nurse, who knows your name, taking the time to do things properly.

When you book with Avida Luna, Shary is the nurse who shows up. Not a call center, and not a rotating staff. She reviews your screening, assesses you in person, places your IV and stays with you for the whole visit, at your home, your office or your event.

She speaks English and Spanish, so you can talk through your care in whichever language feels better for you.
